sections.title: Gout

tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
sections.excerpt: SLE is a chronic autoimmune disease marked by autoantibodies (e.g., ANA, anti-dsDNA), multisystem involvement, and a relapsing-remitting course. It mainly affects women of childbearing age.

sections.excerpt: Systemic sclerosis (scleroderma) is a chronic autoimmune disease marked by skin and organ fibrosis, vasculopathy, and autoimmunity. It causes tissue thickening and can affect the skin, lungs, kidneys, and heart.
